page.layout: One column of running text in the centre-left, with the running head above it. Below the last line are the signature "¶¶ 3" at the foot and the catchword "rum" at the right. No marginal notes, no page number.

main_text.p: chiore Cano, qui integram pa-ginam ex eo transcripsit, sed multò magis ex Salmerone & aliis: qui dum literalem sensum expiscari cupiunt, interdum o-perté, itá tamen ut deprehendi facilè possint, interdum [illegible, ~6 letters] Calvini interpretationem usur-pant. Quam, si fateri hoc vel-lent, mutuatos eos; sin nollent, suffuratos esse dixerim.

3. Enimvero controversiis di-rimendis Pontificiorum mirus consensus & conspiratio esse di-citur: nempe Andabatarum in-star, quod cùm in controversiis aliis, tum sanè in hac Quæstione liquidò constet, in qua fundamenta illa omnia, quæ alii eo-rum

page.notes: The Greek word in the line "interdum ... Calvini" is too small and blurred to read; it is marked as illegible. The paragraph number "3." at the start of the second paragraph is printed in a larger, lighter face and is copied as a plain 3. The running head is set in small capitals and is copied with u/v normalised. The right-hand side of the page carries show-through from the reverse, which is not transcribed.
